statement: This is an app for people who are tired of too many pings from all directions, and want one calm place to stay close to their closest friends, connections and buddies, or their family.
seatsText: One seat for each of your closest friends. When all seven are taken, you free one before you add someone new, so the people who matter never get buried.
lockText: Your messages are locked on your own phone before they leave it, so the app is built to keep them unreadable even for us.
calmText: No feed, no ads and no strangers. Nobody reaches you unless you let them in.
start1: Make your account. It takes a minute.
start2: Write your name, so your friends know who you are.
start3: Press an empty seat to add a friend. Send a friend request, or share a link with them.
start4: Your friend says yes, and a private room opens, just for the two of you. Say hi, or give a poke.
safeboxText: Each friend and each small group has a room of its own, with a safebox for pictures, files, notes, tickets, places and more. Only the people in it share it.
disclaimer: This app is made and operated by BlueBoot R&D AS. It runs in the cloud, and it is secured. User data is encrypted and out of reach for us, the cloud provider or anyone else. BlueBoot R&D AS has no agreements with any third party about the use or operation of this app, besides Google and its use of Google Cloud. It will stay small and independent.
scene6m: Mom: Call me when you can ❤️
scene8m: Lisa: Need a hand with the deck?
reserve: We reserve the right to limit the number of users of this app.
circlesText: There are four circles: Friends, Work, Buddies and Family. Each circle has its own seven seats, its own chats and its own safebox, so what you share in one never shows up in another. The same person can be in more than one circle, and you switch between your circles whenever you like.
circlesFriends: Friends: the people closest to you.
circlesWork: Work: the people you work with.
circlesBuddies: Buddies: your mates and the people you share a hobby with.
circlesFamily: Family: the people at home and your relatives.
sleepText: Need a break from someone? Put them on your sleep list: you stay friends, but you stop hearing from them. If something cannot wait, a poke still gets through.
pokeHeadline: The ones you want shall get through
pokeLine: One poke, and your friend’s phone rings like an alarm. Even on silent. Even at night. Only the friends you gave a seat can do it.
pokeText: When it cannot wait, press the bell on a friend. Their phone rings like an alarm, even on silent, and it says who is poking. Only a friend who has a seat for you can do it. Need quiet? Pause pokes for up to 24 hours; your friends see Silent.
